description: Inspect recent IODA detection evidence and measurement coverage for one entity over a lookback of 1–24 hours. Collect events, alerts, bgp, ping-slash24 and merit-nt evidence. Partial failures remain explicit and route to standalone tools. recent, stale, no_data and unknown describe observation availability; buckets within the 1800-second publication allowance count as pending, not missing. No alerts is not an all-clear. IODA measures macroscopic connectivity, not one office or a shutdown cause.

entityCode.description: Two-letter country code, IODA numeric region code, decimal ASN (AS prefix accepted), or geoasn code joining an ASN and a region or country code (40934-576, 59962-IR); resolve names with ioda_search_entities and pass a returned code here.

entityType.description: country, region, asn, or geoasn (one ASN within a region or country); whitespace and case are normalized.

lookbackHours.description: Hours before the captured invocation time; values above 24 are served as 24 with a notice naming the uncovered earlier window. The exact window is returned.

historyValue.description: Source baseline that value is compared with, on the same per-source scale as value: the source unit for bgp, ping-slash24, and merit-nt; Traffic divided by 1,000,000 and truncated for gtr.

value.description: Source measurement at the transition. bgp (Visible /24s), ping-slash24 (Up /24s), and merit-nt (Unique Source IPs) report it in the source unit; gtr (method sarima) reports IODA Traffic divided by 1,000,000 and truncated to an integer.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_entity`: entityCode is incompatible with entityType, zero or out of range. `upstream_bad_request`: IODA rejects the request with an error envelope or an HTTP 400 other than a missing entity. `upstream_unprocessable`: IODA rejects the request with HTTP 422. `entity_not_found`: A numeric source finds no IODA metadata entity for the code and no event, alert, or series was returned. IODA synthesizes metadata for any ASN, so an unknown ASN reads as no data instead. `upstream_rate_limited`: IODA returns HTTP 429. `upstream_queue_full`: The shared request queue is full. `upstream_schema`: IODA data or bucket metadata does not validate. `response_too_large`: The upstream body or combined response exceeds its byte budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

coverage.description: Observation availability, never health: recent when the latest completed observation ended within the 1800-second publication allowance of asOf, stale beyond it; no_data for an empty series or one with no observation and a missing bucket; unknown for coarse aggregates, no completed bucket, or only pending buckets

from.description: First aggregate bucket anchor, Unix seconds UTC; alignment can place it before the requested from

nullCount.description: Completed in-window missing buckets: interior gaps and trailing nulls that ended more than 1800 seconds before asOf

pendingCount.description: Completed in-window null buckets after the latest observation that ended within 1800 seconds of asOf; not yet due, not a promise they will be published

until.description: Exclusive returned bucket bound, Unix seconds UTC; alignment can place it after the requested until

unit.description: IODA's published unit for this source's values. Coarse buckets aggregate underlying samples in the same unit; values need not equal an unweighted mean of finer returned buckets, and non-null aggregates do not prove complete finer-resolution coverage.

truncated.description: A full page may have further records; not an exact total.
